causal_hypothesis: The 2,048-row local sliding-window attention launch and the independent 2,048x5,376 by 5,376x43,008 FP8 gate/up launch have complementary enough H200 resource use that separate streams reduce their combined critical path.
control: The exact production attention consumer followed by the exact production FP8-linear consumer on one CUDA stream.
candidate: The same immutable inputs and consumers launched concurrently on two distinct CUDA streams.

workload.attention: M=2048, prefix=1024, q_heads=32, kv_heads=16, head_dim=256, bf16 QKV, fp8_e5m2 cache, local window=1024
workload.fp8_linear: M=2048, K=5376, N=43008, fp8_e4m3fn row-scaled activation and column-major weight, bf16 output

quality_gate.attention_serial_concurrent: bitwise equal, finite, complete output consumed
quality_gate.fp8_linear_serial_concurrent: bitwise equal, finite, complete output consumed

decision_gates.close_pair: concurrent median >= 0.90 * component median sum or decisive destructive-interference counters
decision_gates.otherwise: ambiguous component overlap; collect only the preregistered decisive counters

competing_explanation: Both kernels saturate SM/register/shared-memory and L2/HBM resources enough that concurrency merely time-slices or slows one another.
physical_prior: Same-SM co-residency is impossible from measured resources: attention uses 65,280 registers/CTA and FP8 uses 64,512 registers/CTA against 65,536 registers/SM; FP8 also uses 214,016 B dynamic shared memory. A gain requires spatial CTA partitioning across the 132 SMs.
critical_path_method: CUDA-event interval from a timer stream through explicit start and completion event dependencies; never sum overlapping profiler durations.

opportunity.observation: Measured cross-family overlap was 0.001258721 s while attention/KV and FP8 linears owned 28.2473% and 22.9730% of non-overlapping request wall time.
opportunity.evidence_scope: Exact pinned Gemma 4 c32 H200 endpoint trace; dynamic-chunk prefill mixed with decode.
opportunity.mechanism: Schedule independent local-attention and FP8 gate/up regions on separate streams.
opportunity.falsifier: Exact-output concurrent median is >=90% of the component median sum, or counters show destructive interference.

failure_contract: Ordinary import, path, API, numeric-guard, telemetry, or retrieval failures before a decision-bearing invocation are repaired under the same retained claim. A completed producer or scientific arm is not replayed.
transfer_limit: A positive component result supports only this exact operation pair and geometry; runtime or endpoint claims require the preregistered integrated slice.
